title: Blue-Green Cutover for Payment Handler
description:
**SITUATION:**

Finance wants a **full** cutover to Payment Handler `v1.1` with an instant rollback path: bring up a complete **green** stack beside blue, test it privately, then flip the Service to green in one change. Unlike canary, users should not see a mixed version blend after cutover.

This lab is **blue-green**: bring up a full green stack, then flip the Service selector in one cut. Unlike canary, users should not see a mixed version blend after the switch.
**YOUR TASK:**

1. Create the **green** Deployment on image **v1.1** (same replica count as blue).
2. When green is Ready, **switch** Service `payment-handler` to select `color=green`.
3. Leave blue running (rollback safety) but receiving no Service traffic.

**SPEC:**

- Green Deployment name: `payment-handler-green`
  - Replicas: **`3`**
  - Image: `rithvikreddyalkanti/payment-handler:v1.1`
  - Labels: `app=payment-handler`, `color=green`
  - Container port: **8000**
- Service `payment-handler` selector after cutover: `app=payment-handler`, `color=green`
- Blue Deployment remains Ready but not selected by the Service
- Ready: green **3/3**; Service Endpoints point only at green Pods

**CONSTRAINTS:**

- Manifests: `payment-handler-green-l31.yaml` + updated Service in `payment-handler-svc-l31.yaml`.
- Do **not** delete blue as part of the happy path.
- Work only in your lab namespace (not `default`).

problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Blue-Green Cutover for Payment Handler

Stay in your lab namespace. Bring up a full **green** Payment Handler stack on `v1.1`, then flip Service `payment-handler` to `color=green`. Leave blue running for rollback.

Docs: [Deployments](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/controllers/deployment/) · [Services](https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/services-networking/service/)

## Solution YAML

Save as `payment-handler-green-l31.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: payment-handler-green
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: payment-handler
      color: green
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: payment-handler
        color: green
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: payment-handler
          image: rithvikreddyalkanti/payment-handler:v1.1
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8000
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: "100m"
              memory: "128Mi"
```

Save as `payment-handler-svc-l31.yaml` (cutover — selector points at green):

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: payment-handler
spec:
  selector:
    app: payment-handler
    color: green
  ports:
    - port: 8000
      targetPort: 8000
```

## Declarative

```bash
kubectl apply -f payment-handler-green-l31.yaml
kubectl rollout status deploy/payment-handler-green
kubectl apply -f payment-handler-svc-l31.yaml
kubectl get endpoints payment-handler
kubectl get pods -l app=payment-handler -L color
```

Wait until green is **3/3** Ready and endpoints list only green Pods, then **Submit**. Do not delete blue.
